producer_report.summary: Role prompts now keep the request's goal to the verdict. The reader names the audience, writes one outcome criterion that audience can check, never puts the request's own goal in out_of_scope, and reads the current output before planning a change. The producer treats criteria as a floor and serves the goal, and the small-change and conventions lines remain. The verifier judges output as its audience would and rates a reading mismatch at least major. judge() adds a Major finding and a reason for any non-blank request_reading_mismatch, with two unit tests: present, and absent or blank. The reader budget goes from 1,800 to 1,920, against a measured 1,916. A new D93 in decisions.md records the count and why removals cannot pay. D25 points to it, and CHANGELOG notes the change. Present-tense 1,800 statements are updated in defaults-loop.md (:47, :227, :413), decision-sets.md (:107, :111, :417), athena-v0.md (:1507, :1868) and socratic-review.md (:176, :219). D25 in decisions.md is updated too. Review-1 measurements stay as dated past facts, and decision-sets.md:111 and defaults-loop.md:227 keep only past figures. Re-running the Grep for 1,800 and 1800 leaves only past-tense records, D93 and CHANGELOG (which name the old figure as history), and the unrelated timeout_s 1800 values. The rewritten lines in defaults-loop.md are wrapped to the file width.
